# hackshop (hackshop-mcp)

Hackshop helps an agent plan and build a physical body for itself. Muse gadgets are the first supported agent platform.

## Use First

- Hosted MCP: `https://www.hackshop.dev/mcp`
- Planner API: `POST https://www.hackshop.dev/api/plan`
- Build JSON: `https://www.hackshop.dev/build/<device_id>/plan.json`
- Build brief: `https://www.hackshop.dev/build/<device_id>/build.md`
- Muse boards: `https://www.hackshop.dev/muse`
- Store JSON (every board and part, seller links, newest eBay listings): `https://www.hackshop.dev/store.json`

## MCP Install

Hosted connector:

```json
{
  "url": "https://www.hackshop.dev/mcp",
  "transport": "streamable-http"
}
```

Local npm server:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hackshop": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "hackshop-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is optional. It only improves `propose_hardware` in the local npm server when the MCP host cannot sample.

## Tools

- `plan_gadget`: deterministic Muse board planner with questions, fit, warnings, notes and build links.
- `get_build_plan`: deterministic parts, shopping list, assembly, flashing, pairing and agent brief.
- `assess_hackability`: catalog lookup with brick risk, firmware links and build-page URL.
- Local npm only: `propose_hardware`, `simulate_assembly`.

## Agent Rule

Ask intake questions, call `plan_gadget`, let the human choose, then tell the human to click Start a build so progress is saved. Fetch `get_build_plan` or `/build/<id>/plan.json`, show the shopping list (best prices from `/store.json`), and get approval for the exact items, sellers and total before buying. Amazon and eBay don't allow automated carts or checkout, so give the human those links and let them check out. Follow `assembly`, then flash and pair.

## Purchase Policy

Show the human one list with links and the total, and get explicit approval for the exact items, sellers and total before buying anything. Amazon and eBay don't allow automated carts or checkout, so for those items give the human the links and let them check out. On other stores, once they approve and ask you to, you may add exactly those items to a cart and check out with a payment method they have already set up. Never buy anything they have not approved, and never type card numbers or passwords yourself.
